messages:
alyssa: Quick weekly healthcheck for AcmePilot — snapshot below (p95/p99 by route/model, streaming vs sync). Noting a tail spike on streaming /chat-run in the last 24h. TL;DR: onboarding still green but potential renewal risk if tail persists. /cc @june

june: thanks. can you paste the p95/p99 numbers and any error-rate/spend flags?

alyssa: pasted quick snapshot (raw numbers from telemetry):

```
Route: /chat-run
Model: redwood-turbo-alpha
Streaming: p95 210ms, p99 1,120ms
Non-streaming: p95 380ms, p99 2,200ms

Route: /generate
Model: open-magic-3
Streaming: p95 140ms, p99 640ms
Non-streaming: p95 320ms, p99 1,500ms

Errors: overall 0.6% (spike on /chat-run retries)
Spend: +12% WoW (retries + longer tails)
Usage: tokens +18% WoW (onboarding bots)
```

june: ouch, that /chat-run p99 jump is big. any size/payload correlation?

marco: looked at tracing — spikes line up with large KV contexts (>8k tokens) + batcher saturation at ~95% on rpool-4 around 02:00 UTC. attaching short trace: https://traces.redwood/abc123

tim: suspected cause — last infra deploy accidentally left batcher config tuned for throughput. `batch_size` was set to 256 on rpool-4 (should be 64 for low-latency tiers). prepping revert now.

infra-bot: Deploybot: revert initiated by tim. Deploy id 2026-03-18T02:14Z — rpool-4.batch_size => 64. No incident created.

marco: post-revert quick-look (0-30m): /chat-run streaming p99 dropped to ~420ms, non-streaming p99 to ~870ms. still above our target but 60% improvement on p99 tail.

june: action items coming out: 1) document batcher tuning in account runbook, 2) enable prefix/KV caching for the onboarding bots to reduce repeated KV loads, 3) schedule a short renewal-risk touch with AcmePilot to explain mitigation and next 48h plan.

alyssa: I'll own 1 & 3; june pls take 2. I'll also upload the weekly CSV to the account record and flag the renewal as "watch" if tails don't normalize.

june: ack — enabling caching now for the onboarding cohort (feature-flag rollout to 20% then 100%). will post follow-up probe metrics at +6h and +48h.

alyssa: thanks team. I'll update the customer note and spin up a brief summary for the CSM sync. closing when 48h stable. :thumbsup:
